# Picteus

> Extensible local-first framework for indexing and orchestrating AI image assets

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

- [Lists all collections](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/collection-list.md): Returns all the collections.
- [Updates a collection](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/collection-update.md): Enables to modify its name, comment and parameters.
- [Indicates the extension activities](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-activities.md): Returns all the installed and active extensions activities.
- [Builds an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-build.md): Compiles and packages an extension from its source code.
- [Changes the state of an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-change-state.md): Depending on the state, the extension will be stopped or started.
- [Compiles an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-compile.md): Compiles an unpacked extension.
- [Generates an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-generate.md): Scaffolds an extension respecting a set of specifications.
- [Gets the caption instructions for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-get-caption-instructions.md): Returns the caption instructions declared for an extension.
- [Provides the extensions configuration](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-get-configuration.md): Returns the details in terms of all installed extensions capabilities, i.e. what they can offer, and the command they offer.
- [Gets the eligible tags instructions for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-get-eligible-tags-instructions.md): Returns the eligible tags instructions declared for an extension.
- [Gets an extension settings](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-get-settings.md): Returns the settings of an extension.
- [Gets an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-get.md): Returns the details about an extension.
- [Installs a Chrome extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-install-chrome-extension.md): It will only work provided the server is hosted by an Electron application.
- [Installs an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-install.md): Analyzes the extension and installs it.
- [Lists the AI models declared by all extensions](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-list-ai-models.md): Returns the AI models declared by all installed extensions.
- [Lists extensions](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-list.md): Returns all installed extensions matching the search criteria.
- [Resets the settings of an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-reset-settings.md): Reverts the settings of an extension to its default value.
- [Runs a command exposed by an extension, on images](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-run-image-command.md): Runs the command specified for images, by triggering the relevant event to the extension to images matching search parameters.
- [Runs a command exposed by an extension, on the process](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-run-process-command.md): Runs the command defined for the process, by triggering the relevant event to the extension.
- [Sets the AI models declared for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-set-ai-models.md): Overwrites the AI models previously declared for an extension and returns them. An empty array clears them.
- [Sets the caption instructions for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-set-caption-instructions.md): Overwrites the caption instructions declared for an extension.
- [Sets the eligible tags instructions for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-set-eligible-tags-instructions.md): Overwrites the eligible tags instructions declared for an extension.
- [Sets an extension settings](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-set-settings.md): Defines the settings of an extension.
- [Synchronizes the images via an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-synchronize.md): Iterates over all images available in the repositories and asks the extension to operate its work if the image is not indexed by it.
- [Uninstalls an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-uninstall.md): Stops the extension and uninstalls it.
- [Updates an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/extension-update.md): Analyzes the extension and updates it.
- [Gets the closest images to some embeddings attached to an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-closest-embeddings-images.md): Returns the closest images given some embeddings and for a given extension.
- [Gets the image closest images](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-closest-images.md): Returns the image closest images following its specific embedding computed by an extension.
- [Computes the format of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-compute-format.md): Analyzes the provided image, computes its format and returns it.
- [Converts an image into a format](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-convert.md): Converts the provided image into the requested format and returns it.
- [Deletes an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-delete.md): Deletes the image from the back-end and from the databases.
- [Downloads an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-download.md): Returns the binary form of an image.
- [Ensures that features are set on an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-ensure-features.md): Ensures that the provided features are set on an image for a given extension, potentially overwriting existing ones with the same type, format and ...
- [Ensures that tags are set on an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-ensure-tags.md): Ensures that some tags are set on an image for a given extension.
- [Gets all the embeddings of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-all-embeddings.md): Returns the computed embeddings of an image for all extensions.
- [Gets all the features of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-all-features.md): Returns the features of an image for all extensions.
- [Gets all the recipes of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-all-recipes.md): Returns the recipes of an image for all extensions.
- [Gets all the tags of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-all-tags.md): Returns the tags of an image for all extensions.
- [Gets the identifiers of the image collections](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-collection-ids.md): Returns the identifiers of the collections the image belongs to.
- [Gets the embeddings of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-embeddings.md): Returns the computed embeddings of an image for a given extension.
- [Gets all the features of an image for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-features.md): Returns the features of an image given an extension.
- [Gets the metadata of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-metadata.md): Returns all the metadata of an image available in its representation file.
- [Gets the tags of an image for an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get-tags.md): Returns the tags of an image given an extension.
- [Gets an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-get.md): Returns the details about an image.
- [Gets an URL of the image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-media-url.md): Returns the URL of the image, given some given dimensions and format, which may used to display it.
- [Modifies an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-modify.md): Updates the content of an image via a file.
- [Runs capabilities on an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-run-capabilities.md): Runs all extensions capabilities against the image.

- [Run capabilities on images](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-search-run-capabilities.md): Runs all extensions capabilities against the images following search parameters.

- [Retrieves image tags](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-search-tags.md): Retrieves image tags following search parameters.
- [Sets the embeddings of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-set-embeddings.md): Sets the computed embeddings of an image for a given extension.
- [Sets the features of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-set-features.md): Stores the provided features of an image for a given extension.
- [Sets the tags of an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-set-tags.md): Sets the tags of an image for a given extension.
- [Gets the closest images to a text following the embeddings of an extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/image-text-to-images.md): Returns the closest images for a given text which will be turned into embeddings, following the embeddings of a given extension.
- [Declares an image binary attachment](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/imageattachment-create.md): Stores a binary attachment related to an image for a given extension.
- [Downloads an image binary attachment](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/imageattachment-download.md): Retrieves the payload of a binary attachment related to an image for a given extension.

- [Lists extensions](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/marketplace-list.md): Returns the extensions matching the search criteria.

- [Pings the service](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/miscellaneous-ping.md): Enables to check that the service is accessible.

- [Creates a repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-create.md): Declares a new repository.
- [Deletes a repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-delete.md): Deletes a repository along with all the images attached to it.
- [Ensures a repository exists](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-ensure.md): Ensures that a repository with type 'file' and with the provided identifier exists, and if not, creates it.
- [Gets all the embeddings identifiers and names](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-get-embeddings-names.md): Returns all the existing pairs of extension identifier and embedding name, restricted to the extensions with the 'image.embeddings' capability.
- [Gets all the feature names](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-get-feature-names.md): Returns the feature names of all images extensions.
- [Gets an image from its URL](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-get-image-by-url.md): Returns the details about an image.
- [Gets all the tags](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-get-tags.md): Returns the tags of all images extensions.
- [Gets a repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-get.md): Returns a single repository.
- [Lists repositories](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-list.md): Lists all the declared repositories.
- [Renames an image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-rename-image.md): Renames the file of an image in a repository.
- [Starts or stop the repositories](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-start-or-stop.md): Starts all the repositories, resumes synchronization if necessary and starts watching them, or stops them.
- [Creates an image in the repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-store-image.md): Declares an image in the repository and returns it.
- [Synchronizes a repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-synchronize.md): Synchronizes a repository against its back-end.
- [Updates a repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-update.md): Updates the name and comment of a repository.
- [Starts or stops watching a repository](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/repository-watch.md): Starts or stops listening to the repository back-end images changes.

- [CaptionInstruction](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/captioninstruction.md): An instruction for computing captions with an AI model

- [ConstantsRegistry](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/constantsregistry.md): Contains the definition of all the application constants
- [Dates](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/dates.md): A pair of creation and modification dates
- [EligibleTagsInstruction](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/eligibletagsinstruction.md): An instruction for computing eligible tags with an AI model
- [Extension](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extension.md): The full definition of an extension
- [ExtensionActivity](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionactivity.md): The activity of an extension
- [ExtensionActivityState](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionactivitystate.md): The state of the extension
- [ExtensionAiModel](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionaimodel.md): An AI model declared by an extension, with its owner and declaration date
- [ExtensionAndManual](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionandmanual.md): The manual and instructions of an extension
- [ExtensionCategory](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensioncategory.md): The categories the extension belongs to
- [ExtensionGenerationOptions](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensiongenerationoptions.md): The options for generating an extension
- [ExtensionIdImageEmbeddingName](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionidimageembeddingname.md): An extension identifier, plus an embedding name
- [ExtensionImageEmbeddings](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionimageembeddings.md): The image embeddings vectors computed by an extension

- [ExtensionImageFeatureName](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionimagefeaturename.md): A feature name set on an image for a given extension

- [ExtensionImageTag](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionimagetag.md): A tag set on an image for a given extension
- [ExtensionImageTagsAttribute](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionimagetagsattribute.md): Per image extension image tags
- [ExtensionManual](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/extensionmanual.md): The instructions of an extension

- [GenerationRecipeVersion](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/generationrecipeversion.md): The generation recipe schema version
- [Image](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/image.md): Comprehensive information about an image, i.e. all the information about an image
- [ImageDimensions](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagedimensions.md): The dimensions of an image
- [ImageDistance](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagedistance.md): The vectorial distance with a reference image, or given an embedding
- [ImageEmbedding](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imageembedding.md): A vectorial representation of an image, i.e. an image embedding vector, plus a name for that representation
- [ImageFeature](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagefeature.md): An image feature
- [ImageFeatureFormat](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagefeatureformat.md): All the possible formats for an image feature.
- [ImageFeatureNullValue](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagefeaturenullvalue.md): The value to pass to the image search web services to designate a 'non-null' feature value
- [ImageFeatureType](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagefeaturetype.md): All the possible types for an image feature.
- [ImageFormat](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imageformat.md): A filter used by the search which will limit the result entities to those having one of the provided image formats
- [ImageMediaUrl](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagemediaurl.md): The medial URL of an image

- [ImageResizeRender](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imageresizerender.md)
- [ImageSummary](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/imagesummary.md): Basic information about an image, i.e. a summary information about an image
- [InstructionsPrompt](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/instructionsprompt.md): The instructions of an AI-based generated image

- [ManifestCapability](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/manifestcapability.md): The expression of an extension's capability
- [ManifestCapabilityCaptionsDetails](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/manifestcapabilitycaptionsdetails.md): A marker to indicate the capability to compute captions
- [ManifestCapabilityEligibleTagsDetails](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/manifestcapabilityeligibletagsdetails.md): A marker to indicate the capability to compute eligible tags

- [ManifestRuntimeEnvironment](https://picteus.github.io/picteus/docs/manual/webservicesapi/reference/schemas/manifestruntimeenvironment.md): The unique identifier of the runtime environment
